tooltip.flux_turret.gatling_turret: Haha, gun goes BRRRRRRR! Needs a tiny warm-up to spin, then rains absolute bullet hell. Individual damage is smol, but quantity is a quality of its own!
tooltip.flux_turret.tesla_coil: UNLIMITED POWER! Zap zap! Heavy electric shocker that makes monsters do the electric slide. Discharges at a snail's pace, but hits like a flying truck. Bzzzt!
tooltip.flux_turret.prism_tower: A literal L.A.S.E.R. party! Connect multiple shiny towers to summon a giant spicy laser pointer. When they link up, damage and range go stonks!
tooltip.flux_turret.grand_cannon: THE CHAD FRENCH GRAND CANNON. Yeets giant explosive shells from the next zip code. Massive area boom-boom, but environmentally friendly (no block damage). Absolute unit.
tooltip.flux_turret.energy_crystal: A shiny energy stone! Place next to turrets to auto-supply FE power. Can also be recharged by placing above a lit furnace!
tooltip.flux_turret.empowered_energy_cry: A dense energy crystal with roughly 10x capacity and throughput. Built as a power block, not a turret module.
tooltip.flux_turret.empty_crystal: A dull, lifeless crystal... Toss it in a furnace to turn it into a fully charged Energy Crystal!
tooltip.flux_turret.psychic_beacon: Build a metal pyramid base, charge it with redstone! Broadcasts selected buffs all day, then lures monster waves at night. Survive until dawn to earn supply crates!
flux_turret.config.title: gxFlux Configuration

upgrade.flux_turret.slow_rounds: Slow Rounds: Gatling hits briefly slow targets.

upgrade.flux_turret.emp_slow: EMP Slow: Tesla hits slow and weaken affected enemies.
